description.value: Runs the requested task at a duration interval such as 1h for the lifetime of the Factory Session.
Check dependency updates once per hour.

parameters.description: Request to execute at each interval.
parameters.name: request

parameters.description: Positive duration interval from 1s through 168h, such as 30s, 5m, 1h, or 1h30m.
parameters.name: every

parameters.description: Run once immediately after the controller Work is admitted.
parameters.name: triggerAtStart

parameters.description: Stop scheduling after this many consecutive failed executions; zero continues indefinitely.
parameters.name: maxConsecutiveFailures

parameters.description: Model provider for each scheduled execution; omitted values use operator defaults.
parameters.name: executorProvider

parameters.description: Model for each scheduled execution; omitted values use operator defaults.
parameters.name: executorModel

workers.body: At each configured trigger, preserve the complete controller request and create exactly one traceable scheduled execution without rewriting, summarizing, or losing its context.
workers.name: loop-trigger

workers.body: Assume zero prior context. Read the complete scheduled request, inspect any relevant workspace instructions and current state, execute it exactly once for this trigger, verify the outcome, and return a timestamp-independent self-contained result.
workers.name: loop-executor

workstations.body:
This is one isolated occurrence of a recurring request. You have no memory of prior triggers unless their results are explicitly present in the Work input. Read the complete request below, inspect current workspace instructions and state when applicable, and execute it exactly once. Do not create your own timer or loop. Preserve unrelated changes, verify the outcome for this occurrence, and return a self-contained result that states what was done, what evidence was observed, and what could not be completed.

${request}
workstations.name: execute-loop-request
